decisionsTitle: «Direct pe lista de așteptare»: the Administrator vouches for the address at the entry, and the row goes through the allocator at once
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-30,** four days after «Lista internă de așteptare» (§854): «Ar trebui să pot adăuga pe cineva pe lista de așteptare direct, nu neapărat pe cea internă.» Until now the only way onto the official waiting list was the person's own click: the staff entry (BR-REQ-037-05) wrote a `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` row and emailed the link, and the row joined the line only when the link was pressed — so the person the club wrote down after a telephone call or a contact-form message stood nowhere until they found the email, and the internal list was the only place the club could put them at once.

**Decision.** The staff entry (`/admin/registrations/new`) gets a second tick beside the desk's fast track, the Administrator's alone (`canManageRegistrations`, asserted by `createRegistrationByStaff`; the Organizer and the volunteer do not see it, and a forged box is refused before anything is written): «Direct pe lista de așteptare: garantez eu adresa, fără emailul de confirmare.» With it, `submitRegistration` (`origin.addressVouched`) writes the desk's vouching on the new row — `email_confirmed_at` and `email_confirmed_by_staff_user_id`, never the participant's own `email_verified_at`, word for word as the desk (§67) and «Dă-i un loc acum» (§637) write it — and sends the row through the one allocator in the entry's own transaction, under the same event lock: `WAITLISTED` at the back of the line when the event is full, `PENDING_DECLARATION` when a counted place is free, with the outcome's ordinary email («Ești pe lista de așteptare», or the declaration to sign, which starts the hold, §513) and no verification email. A full line refuses the whole entry (§348) and nothing is written — one transaction, so no walk-in's half-state. The held place waits as «Dă-i un loc acum»'s does (`computeVouchedPlaceExpiry`: the window's deadline, or the start; capped by the start alone, never the close), because the person is not at the form reading an email; the public registration window is not consulted, as at the desk — the mode must still be INTERNAL, the event SCHEDULED and dated. Two trail rows under the Administrator's id: `registration.created_by_staff` with the landed state and `addressVouched`, and the new `registration.address_vouched_on_entry` with `from` and `to` — never a name or an address. Under the fast track the tick is ignored: the paper confirmation vouches for the address in person already. From the internal list, «Trece pe lista oficială» opens the same form, so the tick works there too; the panel says in one line, to an Administrator, that the direct way needs no internal line first («Adaugă direct pe lista oficială»).

**What this is not.** Not a place ahead of anyone: the allocator's own order, the line served first (§615), no supplementary place (§642) — a free place is given only because it is free, exactly as the person's own click would have had it. Not a signature: the declaration stays the person's, online from the email or on paper at the desk (`AGENTS.md` §10.8, §15.11). Not silent: §854's refusal of a silent queue stands — the person asked (the relay tick), and gets the email their state earns, with its link to withdraw. Not the Organizer's: vouching for an address changes a registration, which the Organizer reads and does not change (§289), as with «Dă-i un loc acum».

**Refused.** A separate «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» form on the registrations page — the staff entry already asks everything and keeps the duplicate, age and address rules; a second door would be a second allocator entrance to keep in step. A tick that waitlists a person while a place is free — a free place beside a waiting row is what `fillAvailableSpots` exists to prevent. The ordinary thirty-minute hold on a vouched free place — §637's argument applies unchanged.

**Consequences.** `registrations/service.ts` (`RegistrationOrigin.addressVouched`, `submitRegistration`'s `vouchAndAllocate` beside `holdVerification`, `allocateOrWaitlist`'s `vouched` deadline rule), `registrations/admin-service.ts` (`CreateRegistrationByStaffInput.vouchAddress`, the role assertion), `audit/repository.ts` (`registration.address_vouched_on_entry`), `admin/registrations/actions.ts`, `admin/registrations/new/page.tsx` (the tick), `registrations/ui/ReserveListPanel.tsx` and the registrations list page (the one line), `messages/{ro,en}.json`; `AGENTS.md` §10.5 rule 3 and §15.11; CLAUDE.md's staff-verbs row. Tests: `integration/registrations/direct-waitlist-entry.test.ts` (new). No migration, no dependency, no new message type.
changelogLine: - **«Direct pe lista de așteptare» on the staff entry** — an Administrator can enter a person and vouch for their address at once: the registration goes through the allocator in the same transaction, to the back of the waiting list when the event is full or to a declaration hold when a place is free, with the ordinary email for that state and no confirmation link; the internal list points to it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an Administrator entering a registration with «Direct pe lista de așteptare» ticked, when the entry is written, then the row carries the staff vouching for the address (`email_confirmed_by_staff_user_id`), goes through the ordinary allocator in the same transaction — `WAITLISTED` at the back of the line on a full event, `PENDING_DECLARATION` on a free counted place, never ahead of anyone and never a supplementary place — receives that state's ordinary email and no verification email, and is audited as `registration.address_vouched_on_entry`; a full line refuses the whole entry and writes nothing; an Organizer or a volunteer posting the tick is refused; under the fast track the tick is ignored (2026-10-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Direct pe lista de așteptare»: the Administrator vouches for the address at the staff entry, and the row joins the line or takes a free place at once
